parameters.content:
## Receptor Webhook Fiserv (MINIMO)

Objetivo AGORA: ativar este workflow e copiar a URL de PRODUCAO do no Webhook,
e enviar essa URL para a Fiserv cadastrar no ambiente dev.

### Como pegar a URL
1. Ative o workflow (toggle 'Active' no topo).
2. Abra o no 'Webhook Fiserv' -> aba 'Production URL' -> copie.
   Formato: https://SEU-N8N/webhook/fiserv-status-c25bad21

### Importante
- O workflow precisa ficar ATIVO pra URL responder.
- Responde 200 na hora (onReceived) pra nao disparar retry da Fiserv.
- O path tem um token aleatorio (seguranca por obscuridade) ATE a doc definir a autenticacao real.

### Amanha (quando chegar a doc)
Construir ATRAS deste trigger, sem mudar a URL:
validar assinatura/token -> get_result de confirmacao -> carimbar lead -> outbound.

SELECT 
    al.id,
    al.tenant_id,
    al.campaign_id,
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT a.id FROM agents a WHERE a.tenant_id = al.tenant_id AND a.status = 'active' LIMIT 1),
        NULL
    ) AS agent_id,
    al.identifier AS cnpj,
    al.whatsapp AS phone,
    al.name,
    al.metadata
FROM public.agent_leads al
WHERE (al.metadata->>'loan_request_id')::text = '{{ $json.body.id || $json.body.loan_request_id }}'::text
   OR al.identifier = '{{ $json.body.registration_code || $json.body.cnpj }}'
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE agent_leads
SET metadata = metadata
   || jsonb_build_object('fiserv_status', 
        CASE 
          WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'approved' THEN 'comite_approved'
          ELSE '{{ $json.status }}'
        END
      )
   || jsonb_build_object('fiserv_external_status', '{{ ($json.external_status || "") }}'::text)
   || (CASE 
         WHEN '{{ $json.decided }}' = 'true' 
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'fiserv_offer_sent', 'true',
           'fiserv_offer_data', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.offer_data || {}) }}'::jsonb,
           'fiserv_amount_approved', '{{ $json.approved_limit || $json.offer_data?.SomaPrincipal || $json.offer_data?.amount || "" }}',
           'max_installments', '{{ $json.max_installments || $json.offer_data?.installments || "" }}'
         )
         ELSE '{}'::jsonb
       END)
   || (CASE 
         WHEN '{{ $json.has_simulation }}' = 'true'
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'simularam', true,
           'simulation_requested', true,
           'simulated_at', now(),
           'requested_installments', '{{ $json.simulated_installments || 24 }}'::numeric,
           'simulation_data', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.simulation_data || {}) }}'::jsonb
         )
         ELSE '{}'::jsonb
       END)
   || (CASE 
         -- PASSO 5: Quando o comitê formaliza / liquida o crédito (WON)
         WHEN lower('{{ $json.status }}') IN ('won', 'formalized', 'contract_signed', 'disbursed')
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'formalization_status', 'formalized',
           'formalized_at', now(),
           'formalized_amount', COALESCE(
             NULLIF('{{ $json.offer_data?.SomaPrincipal || $json.offer_data?.amount || "" }}', '')::numeric,
             (metadata->'accepted_proposal'->>'amount')::numeric,
             (metadata->'simulation_data'->>'amount')::numeric
           ),
           'formalized_installments', COALESCE(
             NULLIF('{{ $json.offer_data?.installments || "" }}', '')::numeric,
             (metadata->'accepted_proposal'->>'installments')::numeric,
             (metadata->'simulation_data'->>'installments')::numeric
           )
         )
         -- Quando a proposta é reprovada na mesa de formalização
         WHEN lower('{{ $json.status }}') IN ('lost', 'denied', 'cancelled', 'fails_to_process')
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'formalization_status', 'lost',
           'lost_at', now(),
           'lost_reason', '{{ ($json.external_status || "recusado_mesa_credito") }}'
         )
         ELSE '{}'::jsonb 
       END)
WHERE id = '{{ $json.lead_id }}'
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id }}'::uuid;

SELECT 
    c.id                    AS conversation_id,
    c.status                AS conversation_status,
    a.id                    AS agent_id,
    a.evolution_instance,
    a.whatsapp_provider     AS provider,
    a.meta_api_token,
    a.meta_phone_number_id,
    a.zenvia_api_token,
    a.zenvia_channel_id
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN agents a 
    ON a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id 
   AND a.status = 'active'
WHERE c.user_identifier = '{{ $('Consolidar Mensagem e Status').first().json.contact_phone }}'
  AND c.tenant_id = '{{ $('Consolidar Mensagem e Status').first().json.tenant_id }}'::uuid
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
